purpose: Thai → English → Simplified-Chinese patient-facing terminology for the aesthetic-clinic websites (waleeratclinic.com, waleeratinternational.com, verzoclinic.com). Chinese terms are what prospective patients actually search and use (Rednote/Xiaohongshu register), mapped to each site's canonical English program names. This is a linguistic resource: it maps TERMS, never claims, prices or credentials, and must not be used to transfer claims between brands.

reviewStates.site-published-zh: The website itself already publishes this Chinese term (verifiable at the live zh URL recorded in the site's llms.txt snapshot in this repo).
reviewStates.site-canonical: Canonical English program name from the site's own llms.txt program index.
reviewStates.site-keyword: Thai term published by the site as a brand/SEO keyword (clinic.json keywords).
reviewStates.kb-observed-th: Real Thai patient search phrase captured in the verzo evidence knowledge base (Google People Also Ask, intent-only review).
reviewStates.discovery-confirmed: Agreed by >=2 independent sources in glossary/evidence/ (Tavily web discovery). Still needs the logged-in Rednote confirmation pass.
reviewStates.discovery-single-source: Seen in one discovery source only; treat as hypothesis.
reviewStates.unverified-colloquial: Common-usage assertion without evidence captured here; do not use in publication copy.
reviewStates.rednote-search-observed: Term searched on rednote.com (logged-in web session); top-result titles, authors, dates, likes and related-query chips recorded verbatim in glossary/evidence/xhs-*.json.

evidenceModel.platformNote: Verification pass 1 ran 2026-09-09: 16 terms search-verified inside rednote.com using the ZCode in-app browser (logged-in session; the owner's Chrome was left untouched). Raw per-term observations (post titles/authors/dates/likes + related-query chips) are in glossary/evidence/xhs-*.json. Verified entries carry reviewState 'rednote-search-observed'. Note-level verification (opening each post, reading body + comments) is still pending, so translation use should still pass each site's own i18n quality gates.
evidenceModel.disambiguationRule: Nicknames that identify a DIFFERENT product than the one named are recorded under disambiguation, not as translations. Example: 少女针 = Ellansé (PCL), NOT Sculptra — using it for a Sculptra program would misidentify the product.

subTerms.meaning: All-black box; a Thai registration number (อย.) printed on it; black syringe plunger; 2.7 cc per syringe; a scannable QR code on the box.
subTerms.usageNote: Publishable, and the strongest asset here: every point is checkable by the patient while the carton is open in front of them. Stating that the box CARRIES a Thai registration number is description; stating or implying that อย. endorses the product's safety or results is not permitted. Do not reprint the number in copy.

disambiguation.why: RESOLVED by the clinic owner, 2026-09-11. A box holds 2 syringes of 2.7 cc (new package) = 5.4 cc per box; the old package held 2 cc per syringe. CRITICAL: the 9,999 THB price is PER SYRINGE, not per box — a full new-package box is 19,998. The Whisperchat row named 'Rejuran Healer รุ่นใหม่ กล่องละ 2.7 cc' therefore carries the right volume under the wrong word: it prints 'กล่องละ' (per box) for what is a per-syringe price and a per-syringe volume, which promises a patient twice the product their money buys. Never pair 5.4 cc with a single price; quote 2.7 cc per syringe and state the box total only as packaging information.

terms.note: ADJUDICATED (Claude Opus 2026-09-11, medium confidence): primary=丽珠兰. 婴儿针 search surface dominated by NEUE topical serum — match inbound but never headline. Render as 丽珠兰(婴儿针) + qualify 注射. TW=鮭魚針. Watch Livzon(丽珠) pharma confusion. Packaging note 2026-09-11: syringe volume moved 2 cc → 2.7 cc; a box holds 2 syringes (new package 5.4 cc per box), but the price is quoted PER SYRINGE — see disambiguation before writing any volume next to a price. Both clinics stock the new package, so a white syringe is old stock.
